mapper.select: select korean_card_id from korean_cards where korean_card_id in ( select distinct kc.korean_card_id from korean_cards kc join card_topics ct on kc.korean_card_id=ct.korean_card_id join foreign_cards fc on kc.korean_card_id=fc.korean_card_id where ct.topic_id=#{topic} and fc.language_code=#{code} ) order by korean_word LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ;

select count(korean_card_id) from korean_cards where korean_card_id in ( select distinct kc.korean_card_id from korean_cards kc join card_topics ct on kc.korean_card_id=ct.korean_card_id join foreign_cards fc on kc.korean_card_id=fc.korean_card_id where ct.topic_id=#{topic} and fc.language_code=#{code} );
